Source contracts: build.ps1

build.ps1

PowerShell · Tier B

Forward native Windows packaging arguments and preserve the builder exit status.

Usage

./build.ps1 [builder options] from PowerShell.

Inputs

SMTO_BUILD_PYTHON selects the interpreter; otherwise use python on PATH.

Side effects

Invokes binary_builder.py, whose host policy selects supported components and owns downloads, staging, compilation, optional signing and release outputs.

Cleanup

The child builder owns temporary-stage cleanup; the wrapper exits with its status.

@see scripts/binary_builder.py
